scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The exact square profile is derived from the established radial-mean covariogram and cube moment formulas. The new claimed contribution is the full Euclidean global contact-direction classification and its sharp parameter transition. Numerical and rational checks corroborate the displayed analytic proof; no formal verification or outside expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Restricted to the centered square in the Euclidean metric and finite real p>-1. The general cube integral and axial/diagonal formulas are known from arXiv:2601.20117v2, Proposition 34; an earlier equivalent square angular computation remains possible. The foundational 1998 full text was not available for inspection.

title: A four-to-four contact transition in radial mean bodies of the square
